entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Uh, not like that. It's okay though![n]Just aim for the arm your enemy's[n]holding his gun with.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: ...That's it!

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: I've got nothing left to teach you.[n]You're an elite player now,[n][lName]-san.
Thanks to my hard work.
Thanks to my teacher.[clr 27]

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: True... but my instructions played[n]a big part in it, too.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: It's because you worked so hard.[n]I didn't really do that much...

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Actually, yeah I did! *chuckle*

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Have you noticed that my playing style[n]has changed? I feel calmer when I'm[n]under pressure now.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: I wonder if it's because I'm not so[n]obsessed with winning anymore...

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Hey... I invited some people here today.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: They should be arriving any[n]minute now...

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Oh, here they are.

entries.speaker: Defiant Boy
entries.en: So what did you want to talk to us about?

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: ...I'm sorry!

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: I finally realized that I was being selfish...

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Please forgive me.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: I'll understand if you guys don't, but...

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: ...I promise I'll pay back the money as[n]soon as I save up enough.

entries.speaker: Defiant Boy
entries.en: ...Well, what do you wanna do?

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: That's all I wanted to say...

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Thanks for coming.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Let's go.

entries.speaker: Quiet Boy
entries.en: Wait!

entries.speaker: Quiet Boy
entries.en: I'm not very good at Gun About...[n]Will you teach me how to get better?

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Huh? Then...

entries.speaker: Takekuma
entries.en: Sorry, kids, I don't mean to interrupt...

entries.speaker: Quiet Boy
entries.en: Hey, it's the pro gamer...!

entries.speaker: Takekuma
entries.en: It's been a while, hasn't it, kid?[n]You want to play a game?

entries.speaker: Takekuma
entries.en: I haven't faced any worthy[n]opponents lately.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: ...I've gotten better since we[n]last played, you know. Now I can[n]stay calm during a battle.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: I'm gonna blast right through[n]that pitch black armor of yours.

entries.speaker: Takekuma
entries.en: ...So then, you believe the rumor[n]that's being told about me, eh?

entries.speaker: Takekuma
entries.en: Well, a full display of my skills should[n]put an end to that lie.

entries.speaker: Takekuma
entries.en: ...What the hell!?[n]I-I can't even shoot!

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: ...Take that.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Don't aim for the body...

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: ...And that!

entries.speaker: Takekuma
entries.en: ...Tch! This is BS!

entries.speaker: Arcade Spectator
entries.en: Whoa, the champ can't even[n]get off a shot!

entries.speaker: Loud Spectator
entries.en: Takekuma's about to lose![n]The King's going to win!

entries.speaker: Takekuma
entries.en: Wha— I lost?

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Stop using that armor and start[n]playing fair and square.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: It's unacceptable to break the[n]rules just to win, whether you're[n]an adult or a child.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: And if you don't stop, I'll tell everyone.

entries.speaker: Takekuma
entries.en: ...No, I won't admit defeat!

entries.speaker: Takekuma
entries.en: I just can't! It'll be the end of everything!

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: No it won't. Your life will go on,[n]even after you lose.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: But if you don't change now, then[n]it might really be the end for you.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: And then no one will be able to help you.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: I don't want you to go through that.

entries.speaker: Takekuma
entries.en: Well said... for a kid...

entries.speaker: Takekuma
entries.en: I'm not going to enter the tournament.[n]See ya.

entries.speaker: Defiant Boy
entries.en: ...That was totally insane, dude![n]You beat a professional gamer!

entries.speaker: Quiet Boy
entries.en: The King's the new champ!

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: No... I'm not. I haven't won the[n]tournament yet.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Besides, it's thanks to you guys...[n]that I was able to get stronger.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: ...Everyone's gone home.[n]We should get going too.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: ...I'm so happy right now.
You got your revenge.
You made things right.
You made new friends.[clr 27]

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: ...No, it's not that.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: I'm happy that I made some[n]new friends...

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: ...Yeah, I think we'll get along fine from[n]now on.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Yeah...

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: I've always thought that winning was[n]the coolest thing.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: But being nice is pretty cool too...

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Losing wasn't the end.[n]It was just a new beginning.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Through all the pain, and with[n]your help...

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: I was able to change.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Now it's my turn to help others.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: My mom, my friends... even[n]people I don't know.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: I wonder...

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Will that help me become a member of[n]the Phantom Thieves?
I'll let you in.
Ask them yourself.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: So you ARE one of them, after all!?

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: ...That's why I'm asking you.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Don't worry. I won't tell anyone.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Well, this is the last time we'll[n]play together.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: There's nothing left to teach you,[n]and the Phantom Thieves seem[n]to be having a rough time...

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Don't worry. I won't tell anyone.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Well, this is the last time we'll[n]play together.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Thank you...

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: ...For hanging out with a lonely kid like[n]myself.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: ...I'll continue to do my best.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Okay, put out your hand.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Good luck, [lName]-san!
I feel a strong bond with Shinya...

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: This is my ultimate move!

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: ...You've gotten really good! But[n]you'll still never be able to beat me!

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: You won't lose to anyone else though!

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: *chuckle*

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: I'll be supporting you, no matter what...!

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Later!
